title: LG’s budget-friendly B6E OLED TV is up to 50 percent off this weekend
description: LG’s B6E was already one of the most affordable OLED TVs you could buy, but it’s an even better deal now that it’s included as part of Best Buy’s latest doorbus

content.summary: LG’s B6E was already one of the most affordable OLED TVs you could buy, but it’s an even better deal now that it’s included as part of Best Buy’s latest doorbuster event. Now through the end of today, November 15th, the 55-inch model is 50 percent off, dropping it to an all-time low of $699.99 ($700 off) at Best Buy. If you want a larger 4K set, the 65- and 77-inch models are also discounted, dropping them to $999.99 ($900 off) and $1,499.99 ($1,200 off), respectively. LG B6E OLED TV Where to Buy: $1399.99 $699.99 at Best Buy (55-inch) $1899.99 $999.99 at Best Buy (65-inch) $2699.99 $1499.99 at Best Buy (77-inch) Although it’s not as bright as LG’s pricier C6, the B6E still delivers the excellent contrast and deep blacks OLEDs are often praised for. It’s nearly identical to the standard B6, except it comes with a simpler remote that lacks the motion controls and voice features found on LG’s Magic Remote. It supports Dolby Vision and HDR10 for more lifelike colors and detail...
